verdict.rationale: Spline has its own file-level Version History that lets users preview saved versions, track changes and recover previous file states. Its automation logic (states, events, actions and webhooks) lives inside those files, so the docs imply but never state that this versions automations. There is no automation-specific versioning, diffing or review flow. Missing for 10: automation-level version tracking, change diffs or review of interactivity/webhook logic, explicit docs that rollback covers automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: This feature helps you track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions as needed.
Version History allows you to access and preview all the saved versions of your files.
Most interactivity in Spline needs no code at all. It's built from **states, events and actions**
